decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 4 - The ground floor window, proposed in the western elevation, shall be obscurely glazed to level 3 within the Pilkington range of textured glass, or equivalent. This shall not be changed to plain glass unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority

Condition : 5 - It is considered that this application for the erection of a single storey rear extension to the existing dwelling, would not be detrimental to the appearance of the original dwelling, the character of the street scene or to the amenities of the adjoining and neighbouring properties.  On balance, the development is in accordance with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003; and is generally compliant with Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.  It is considered that where the development is not compliant there are no undue adverse effects resulting from this.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to existing dwellinghouse.
